olivia_cs: Heads-up team — Orbis Analytics renewal (150 seats) is ready to sign but two blockers: procurement needs vendor code swap to ORB-555 and legal wants a short SOC2 addendum before signature. They also asked if we can honor the 9mo discount we quoted verbally. Need quick sync.
marc_sales: Is the 9mo discount already approved or was that a one-off? I told the buyer we'd hold it if they sign by EOW.
tara_fin: I don't see an approved pricing override in the system. If we apply the 9mo tier discount we need revenue ops sign-off for this customer size. Can we get an exception?
wayne_legal: SOC2 addendum is straightforward but security needs to confirm the exact language about audit logs. I can draft a 1-paragraph addendum that references existing security controls and attach to SOW. That takes ~2 business hours.
eva_enablement: They requested a kickoff next Monday. We can do a pre-kick with access to sandbox, but require signed docs for production access.
marc_sales: Proposed flow: 1) Sales confirms discount and requests revenue ops exception 2) Finance updates invoice and vendor code -> ORB-555 3) Legal drops SOC2 addendum into DocuSign 4) Send envelope to procurement (procure@orbis.ai) then CFO.
tara_fin: I can change invoice today once pricing sign-off received. New invoice will be INV-2026-90077. Note: billing automation requires exact vendor code ORB-555 or PO will bounce.
wayne_legal: Draft SOC2 addendum below, feedback welcome:
```
SOC2 addendum:
Redwood Inference attests that production systems processing Customer data comply with our SOC2 controls. Redwood will provide Customer with SOC2 Type II report upon request under NDA.
```
marc_sales: That looks good. I'll ask revenue ops for net-30 + 9mo exception. Buyer prefers net-30.
tara_fin: Net-30 approval pending; looping revenue-ops now. If approved, we'll reflect terms on INV-2026-90077.
docusign-bot: DocuSign envelope created https://app.docusign.com/envelope/EXAMPLE98765 status: awaiting attachments.
wayne_legal: Attached addendum and updated SOW now. Go ahead and send when invoice updated.
docusign-bot: Envelope EXAMPLE98765 updated and sent to procure@orbis.ai at 2026-04-02T11:20:00Z.
eva_enablement: I'll hold Mon 09:00 PT slot for kickoff if envelope signs by EOD Fri. If not, I'll push to Tue.
olivia_cs: Quick checklist recap: Marc to confirm discount and revenue ops exception; Tara to publish INV-2026-90077 with ORB-555; Wayne to attach SOC2 addendum; Marc to send DocuSign to procurement. I'll follow-up with buyer and post updates here. :thumbsup:
